baseline.note: levels are the 99th percentile while learning; how far outside counts as wrong is effente.safety.OUTSIDE_NORMAL (starting values)

fault_classifier.note: learned from injected signature patterns only; no real labelled faults yet

fault_types.name: vibration_too_high
fault_types.text: overall vibration well above this machine's normal

fault_types.name: unbalance_like
fault_types.text: once-per-turn vibration grown (unbalance, a bent shaft, a lost blade)

fault_types.name: misalignment_like
fault_types.text: twice-per-turn vibration grown (misalignment, a worn coupling)

fault_types.name: looseness_or_rattle
fault_types.text: many harmonics, half-order and rattling (looseness, a soft foot, a cracked mount)

fault_types.name: repeating_knock
fault_types.text: a knock or click that repeats (damaged belt splice, gear tooth, clicking drive)

fault_types.name: impacts
fault_types.text: jolts or bangs much more often than usual (collisions, a jam, loose parts hitting)

fault_types.name: bearing_defect_like
fault_types.text: pulses at bearing defect rates in vibration or high-pitched sound (rolling-bearing wear)

fault_types.name: speed_change
fault_types.text: running speed away from its usual (belt slip, a failing drive, a different load)

fault_types.name: electrical_motor
fault_types.text: twice-mains vibration and hum grown (motor electrical fault, a failing supply)

fault_types.name: new_tone_whine_squeal
fault_types.text: a new or louder tone (whine, squeal, a belt or bearing singing)

fault_types.name: grinding_or_hiss
fault_types.text: rough high-pitched noise (grinding, lubrication loss, cavitation, arcing)

fault_types.name: alarm_or_beeping
fault_types.text: a tone switching on and off (an alarm, a warning beeper, a UPS on battery)

fault_types.name: overheating
fault_types.text: hotter than usual for this machine

fault_types.name: heating_up_over_time
fault_types.text: temperature climbing over hours, days or weeks

fault_types.name: local_hot_spot
fault_types.text: one small part heating (a connection, a bearing, a cable, a contact)

fault_types.name: area_running_cold
fault_types.text: an area cooler than usual (a stopped fan, blocked fins or flow, a failed heater)

fault_types.name: excess_temperature_fluctuation
fault_types.text: temperature swinging more than usual (cycling, hunting, an intermittent fault)

fault_types.name: unsteady_vibration_or_sound
fault_types.text: vibration or sound coming and going more than usual (intermittent fault)

fault_types.name: room_too_hot_or_humid
fault_types.text: the room warmer or damper than usual (cooling failure, condensation risk)

fault_types.name: device_moved
fault_types.text: the device has been moved or knocked (its tilt changed)

fault_types.name: camera_moved_or_blocked
fault_types.text: the thermal image no longer looks like its usual view
